summary: Corrispettivi giornalieri (SIMULATED cassetto fiscale) tested end to end. Backend: new suite test_iteration15_corrispettivi.py, 16/16 passed. It covers sync roles (operatore 403, contabile/admin 200, unauthenticated 401), the first sync creating 26 days (2026-10-01..10-30, Sundays excluded), a second sync returning ricevuti 0 with no duplicates, the record structure (matricola 99MEX+last 6 digits of the P.IVA, VAT scorporata with imponibile+imposta=lordo, aliquote 22/10/4, n_documenti 8..90), totals per aliquota, the dal/al filter (bad dates ignored), company isolation, deleting a middle day (not re-added) and deleting the last day (re-added deterministically), riepilogo (ultimo, mese, totale_anno, giorni, mesi[12], empty state) and liquidazione mensile/trimestrale (iva_corrispettivi = sum of imposta, documenti_corrispettivi, added to iva_debito together with invoice VAT). Regression: test_iteration12_iva and test_iteration13_reverse_charge, 22/22 passed. Frontend (Playwright): nav-corrispettivi goes to /corrispettivi. Empty state -> sync -> toast 'Ricevuti 26 giorni di corrispettivi' and 26 rows. Second sync shows 'Nessun nuovo corrispettivo'. Delete with confirm removes the row. Period filter works (M9 empty, T4 rows). riva-totali and corr-totale-periodo are shown, the print button is visible. Dashboard corrispettivi-panel shows cp-ultimo, cp-mese and cp-anno (matching the page total) and cp-chart with 26 bars. cp-open-link works. Liquidazione shows liq-corr-10 (October 5129,62 €) and liq-corr-totale, and da_versare matches. Operatore does not see the sync and delete buttons. Mobile layout is fine (the table scrolls horizontally).

minor.issue: Only reads docs with anno == current year, so in early January 'giorni' (last 30 days) misses the December days and 'ultimo' is None even if recent data exists.

insert_many errors are caught with a bare 'except Exception: pass' and 'ricevuti' still reports len(docs). On concurrent syncs (double click from two tabs) or a real DB error, the count is wrong and the error is hidden. Catch BulkWriteError only and use nInserted.

Re-sync only fetches days after the last stored date (capped at 62 days back). A deleted middle day can never be fetched again, and a gap longer than 62 days is silently skipped. This may be acceptable for the simulation but should be documented or handled with a per-day re-fetch when the real integration arrives.

action_items: Optional: in riepilogo, query the last 30 days by date rather than anno == current year (year-boundary case).
Optional: catch only BulkWriteError in sync and return the actual inserted count.
critical_code_review_comments: corrispettivi_sync: the bare except hides every DB error; ricevuti is not the real inserted count.
corrispettivi_riepilogo: the 'giorni' and 'ultimo' window is limited to the current year (January edge case).
Unique index (company_id, data, matricola) correctly prevents duplicates.
